name: manual_9ca351
claim: A narrow verify interface that wraps the full authority narrows the API, not the capability; check what the verifier object can reach (seed, secret, writes), not what its methods expose.

decisions.notes: The serving verifier wrapped the full grant authority, so it could still reach the signing seed and write issuer state.

rationale: The serving verifier wrapped the full grant authority, so it could still reach the signing seed and write issuer state.
